title: 2009 HMMT February General Round 1 Problem 1
statement: If \(a\) and \(b\) are positive integers such that \(a^{2}-b^{4}=2009\), find \(a+b\).

solutions.text: We can factor the equation as \(\left(a-b^{2}\right)\left(a+b^{2}\right)=41 \cdot 49\), from which it is evident that \(a=45\) and \(b=2\) is a possible solution. By examining the factors of 2009 , one can see that there are no other solutions.
